system.description: An extremely rare atavism (fewer than a dozen reported instances since the clan's founding): your character does not bear the Curse of Lamia, and your Kiss causes no more pleasure or pain than ordinary blood loss. You acquire a peculiar cadaverous pallor upon the Embrace that no amount of blood ingestion can flush away, giving you a one-Trait resolution penalty on all Social Challenges relying on Appearance-related Traits (special corpse-like makeup is recommended). The Giovanni are quite superstitious about this trait and afford those who carry it a wide berth.
system.source: Clanbook: Giovanni, Chapter Two: It Runs in the Family
